quarantinedPreFixProvenance.hardwareParityMode: Symmetric Turn-2 re-evaluation: Turn-1 shared from t1only cache; Turn-2 Arm 1, Arm 3A, Arm 3B, and Arm 3AB-Hybrid all generated on the same GPU VM.
quarantinedPreFixProvenance.colabGpuStockoutLog: 2026-11-24 Colab Pro+ backend returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable across all >=80GB and fallback GPU pools (A100, H100, G4; 0.00 CU burned, Active assignments: 0 verified, balance preserved at 3132.29 / 3251.14 CU = 118.85 CU spent).
quarantinedPreFixProvenance.defectRootCause: Pre-fix build_arm3a_ledger_from_prompts extracted Turn-1 state_v1 commitment on non-Condition-E episodes whenever Turn-1 raw JSON emitted a spurious 'preserved' key, causing augment_turn2_prompt_with_ledger to instruct emitting 'preserved' on Condition A..D and triggering oracle schema PARSE_REJECT (50/50 Condition A failure, 28/100 ITT pass).
quarantinedPreFixProvenance.remediationNote: Patched in arm3_ledger_hook.py (gated state_v1 extraction on bool(t2_preserved)) and arm3_state_diff.py (apply_structural_gate_only non-E preserved strip); archived pre-fix JSONL and t1only cache preserved on disk and R2 for audit provenance.
